message: class="badge {{user.tier}}" on <span> comes from a field, and no style can follow it
hint: td;dr inlines the stylesheet when it builds, so a class the ESP fills in later matches no rule. Write one copy of the element per class, each with its class fixed and under its own condition (v-if / v-else in Vue, cond ? <A/> : <B/> in JSX, data-email-if / -unless in HTML).
